analysis: Season 1.5 derived analytical summaries; not raw organiser payloads
basis: Reconstructed exchange fill/funding account histories. No licensed external market data or organiser API response is bundled.

scope: This compact Quantlet recalculates statistics from derived account/date data. It does not rerun raw transaction reconstruction or independently validate valuations.
